posts.title: A Bucket List for Momma
posts.description: I wish I could've done this for my dad but he was so against everything I offered or suggested, it was simply too late. I live with many regrets of "why didn't I take him up on that" and "I wish he let me go with them" but all is said and done. There is still momma — more fragile as the days go by (and more annoying).
